budget_rule.additional_clause_order: retrieval rank, then selected clause order
budget_rule.mandatory: first Run 014 selected clause from every retrieved record
budget_rule.mandatory_overflow: retain mandatory clauses even if they exceed the budget
budget_rule.overflow: stop admitting optional clauses before the first overflow; never truncate a clause
budget_rule.provenance: record every retained and omitted source record, rank, and selected-clause index

hypothesis: A fixed 128-token rank-aware budget can reduce Run 014 context while preserving retrieval quality, held-out evidence, and provenance.
measurement_notes: Run 014 top-five document IDs are replayed, isolating context assembly from embedding and retrieval.
Context tokens use the established chars/4 approximation; held-out quality uses the frozen evidence-term subset proxy.
Retrieval metrics are unchanged by construction; no answer-generating model is evaluated.
Assembly timing repeats each frozen query and peak RSS is the Linux process-lifetime high-water mark.
notes: Rejected: the fixed budget did not reduce context on both frozen sets while preserving quality, provenance, and acceptable assembly latency.
